hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Spain's snap general election on November 29 reaches its fever-pitch conclusion as Vox leader Santiago Abascal rallies supporters in Valencia while pushing hardline remigration policies and massive public spending cuts. Media coverage across Europe highlights Vox as a potential kingmaker that could propel the far right into power for the first time since Franco, triggering intense counter-mobilization from Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.
hotspots.affect: Commands maximum affective investment driven by high-stakes election panic, polarized debates over national identity and immigration, and intense ideological clashes over potential far-right government entry.

hotspots.title: Jordan Bardella Faces Explosive Antisemitism Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National president Jordan Bardella continues to battle mounting revelations regarding alleged past antisemitic social media accounts, drawing fierce condemnations across French politics. Marine Le Pen and RN leadership have launched an aggressive counter-offensive against investigative journalists and the press, threatening legal crackdowns and accusing media outlets of political intimidation.
hotspots.affect: Combines moral outrage over antisemitism accusations with aggressive anti-media grievance framing and defensive siege rhetoric from the French right.

hotspots.title: Swedish Government Crisis & SD Coalition Negotiations
hotspots.blurb: Political turmoil engulfs Sweden's party landscape as internal revolt strikes the Center Party (C) over proposals that would allow a government dependent on the Sweden Democrats (SD). SD leaders signal confidence in their expanding leverage over budget priorities and governance, sparking warnings of institutional betrayal among Swedish centrists.
hotspots.affect: Charged with institutional anxiety, betrayal narratives, and contentious debate over normalizing far-right influence in national decision-making.

hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains under medical care in Brasília following severe abdominal health complications, with updates on his ICU progress monitored closely by supporters. Meanwhile, Bolsonarismo faces renewed legal scrutiny as Senator Flávio Bolsonaro remains in the United States while continuing to draw his Senate salary.
hotspots.affect: Generates emotional investment through health crisis sympathy while maintaining high political friction around the legal and financial actions of the Bolsonaro family.

hotspots.title: Meloni Confronts Zelenskyy Over Uncoordinated Libyan Naval Strike
hotspots.blurb: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni engaged in a clarification call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy following a secret Ukrainian military operation targeting a Russian warship off the coast of Libya. Meloni declared that Italian national interests and Mediterranean security take precedence over unconditional support for Kyiv, while Zelenskyy offered apologies and pledged future operational transparency.
hotspots.affect: Sparks intense political charge by pitting sovereign national interest and regional escalation fears directly against Western aid to Ukraine.
